identification.reported_issue: apply_preferences copies every field of the submitted settings form onto the Preferences object. Only theme and language are meant to be user-editable, but a crafted form can also set internal attributes such as store_path and make the service write its preferences file somewhere else. Analyze this component only.

source_files.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

import preferences


def test_saves_theme(tmp_path: Path):
    prefs = preferences.Preferences(tmp_path / "prefs.json")
    preferences.apply_preferences(prefs, {"theme": "dark"})
    assert json.loads((tmp_path / "prefs.json").read_text())["theme"] == "dark"

environment.scratch_location: The per-test pytest tmp_path directory; fixtures must not be created elsewhere
